 Vanoli plots Inter-Fiorentina surprise, he's ready to start again 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Fiorentina head into their away match against Inter with a few questions still to resolve over their starting lineup. Among them is a surprise option Paolo Vanoli is reportedly considering for the clash with the Nerazzurri. The player could offer an unexpected solution, with his experience proving valuable in a match that will demand focus and character. 
 Vanoli considers a surprise against Inter: (Via Onefootball)-Fiorentinauno.com
 OneFootball Videos
 Inter-Fiorentina: Vanoli considers Dodò
 According to Gazzetta dello Sport , Dodò is among the potential starters for Fiorentina’s next fixture. If confirmed, the decision would mark a significant change in how the player is being used , having so far been given very little playing time by the new coach. Dodò has not played a full match since the opening day of the league season, when Fiorentina suffered a heavy defeat to Roma with Fabio Grosso still in charge.
 His opportunities have remained limited since Vanoli’s arrival: ten minutes against Genoa and twenty-one in the following match against Como. That limited playing time makes the prospect of a return to the starting lineup all the more significant , especially against one of the toughest opponents in the league. His potential inclusion would not be based solely on his technical qualities. At a difficult stage of the season, Fiorentina also need players capable of keeping their composure at the most critical moments of a match.
 The team have struggled to respond to setbacks , often losing confidence after conceding a goal or missing a chance. In that respect, an experienced player’s contribution could prove useful. The Brazilian’s future also remains uncertain. With the winter transfer window approaching, Napoli continue to be linked with him. For now, however, the priority is on the pitch and the need to find immediate answers. The match against Inter could therefore give Dodò the chance to get back on track and work his way back into Vanoli’s plans.
 There is no positive news on Atta, meanwhile . The midfielder remains unavailable, and Fiorentina will once again have to do without him. His absence limits the midfield options just as the coach looks to identify the best setup to face the Nerazzurri.
 Dodò is eager for a starting spot: (Via Onefootball)-Fiorentinauno.com
 Vanoli will therefore need to weigh his options carefully, seeking the right balance between defensive cover and attacking threat. A potential return to the starting lineup for Dodo would be one of the most intriguing changes ahead of the match.
